description: In every PA-model, each \(n\) has a positive common multiple of all positive \(j\le n\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.common_multiple_model.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (n : M) :
  ∃ d,
    d ≠ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M ∧
      ∀ (i : M),
        i ≠ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M →
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M i n →
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.DividesModel M i d
